title: Evaluation of Discharge Management according to paragraph 39 section 1a, Social Insurance Code V of people who are situated in (semi-)inpatient psychiatric treatment - Insurance claims data analysis
summary:
Overall Project E2-PSY: The transition from inpatient to outpatient care is often a major challenge for people with mental illnesses. The so-called discharge management (DM) is intended to help facilitate this phase. It includes various services such as sociotherapy, outpatient psychiatric care, occupational therapy, and digital health applications to ensure seamless follow-up treatment. However, discharge management in psychiatry has not yet been comprehensively studied in Germany. The E2-PSY project, in collaboration with the Techniker Krankenkasse (TK), is conducting a systematic evaluation of this process for the first time. A mix of different research methods is being used for this purpose. 

Study: In Work Package 1 (AP1), health insurance data from TK-insured who were in (semi-)inpatient psychiatric treatment between January 1, 2022, and December 31, 2023, will be analyzed. The main focus of this study is to assess the impact of discharge management on readmission rates for further psychiatric treatment. Additionally, the study will examine hospital stays (length of stay and number of inpatient treatment days), treatment diagnoses, the number of outpatient prescriptions as part of discharge management, the time until the first outpatient contact, and outpatient services.

interventions.name: No interventional study. A full survey of all insured individuals of the participating statutory health insurance is conducted, covering treatments in the years 2022–2023. The data source is routine data (billing data) from statutory health insurance.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Techniker Krankenkasse insured
At least one inpatient, semi-inpatient, or inpatiente equivalent psychiatric or psychosomatic treatment between January 1, 2022, and December 31, 2023
Exclusion criteria:
No continuous insurance status with Techniker Krankenkasse during the study period
Employees of Techniker Krankenkasse
Individuals listed with a data protection notice at Techniker Krankenkasse
Individuals who have objected to the use of their data for research purposes at Techniker Krankenkasse
